     6	/-!
     7	# The low-degree game
     8	
     9	This file introduces the finite question and answer alphabets used by the
    10	low-degree component of the Pauli basis test.  The maps are explicit maps on
    11	the ambient coefficient space, and their conditional-linearity levels are
    12	established below; the line-point distributions they induce are analysed in
    13	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Test/LowDegreeGameTheorems.lean`.
    14	
    15	## References
    16	
    17	The source-facing nodes are `def:ld-game`, `def:ld-question-distribution`, and
    18	`def:ld-win-predicate` in
    19	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`; their paper origin is
    20	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	open scoped BigOperators
    24	
    25	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    26	
    27	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    28	
    29	noncomputable section
    30	
    31	/-- Numerical parameters for the low-degree game.  The ambient coefficient
    32	space uses the once-and-for-all model `fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq`, rather than a
    33	model supplied by each parameter record.  This is the Lean carrier for
    34	`def:ld-game` in
    35	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, with paper origin
    36	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    37	-/
    38	structure LdParams where
    39	  q : ℕ
    40	  m : ℕ
    41	  d : ℕ
    42	  k : ℕ
    43	  hm : 1 ≤ m
    44	  hd : 1 ≤ d
    45	  hk : 1 ≤ k
    46	  hq : IsAdmissibleSize q
    47	  hdvd : m ∣ q
    48	
    49	/-- The positive dimension in `LdParams` supplies the finite coordinate type
    50	used by the uniform axis and prefix-index marginals. -/
    51	instance (L : LdParams) : Nonempty (Fin L.m) :=
    52	  ⟨⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one L.hm⟩⟩
    53	
    54	/-- The fixed model accessor for an `LdParams` record.  It is a compatibility
    55	view of the global `fixedFieldModel` selector, not an independently quantified
    56	parameter.  Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    57	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    58	-/
    59	noncomputable def LdParams.model (P : LdParams) : FixedFieldModel P.q :=
    60	  fixedFieldModel P.q P.hq
    61	
    62	/-- The scalar carrier selected by an `LdParams` record; this is the fixed
    63	field carrier in `def:ld-game`, selected globally by `LdParams.model`.
    64	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    65	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    66	-/
    67	abbrev ScalarQ (P : LdParams) := (P.model).K
    68	
    69	/-- The three low-degree question types of `def:ld-game`, blueprint
    70	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`, paper origin
    71	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    72	-/
    73	inductive LdType where
    74	  | point
    75	  | aline
    76	  | dline
    77	  deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, Fintype
    78	
    79	/-- The register index used by the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    80	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    81	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    82	-/
    83	abbrev LdIndex (P : LdParams) := (Fin P.m ⊕ Unit) ⊕ Fin P.m
    84	
    85	/-- The full ambient low-degree coefficient space (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
    86	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
    87	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
    88	-/
    89	abbrev LdSpace (P : LdParams) := LdIndex P → ScalarQ P
    90	
    91	/-- The point coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
    92	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    93	-/
    94	def LdSpace.point {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
    95	  fun i => z (.inl (.inl i))
    96	
    97	/-- The shared scalar coordinate of an ambient low-degree vector in
    98	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
    99	-/
   100	def LdSpace.seed {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : ScalarQ P :=
   101	  z (.inl (.inr ()) )
   102	
   103	/-- The direction coordinates of an ambient low-degree vector in
   104	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   105	-/
   106	def LdSpace.direction {P : LdParams} (z : LdSpace P) : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   107	  fun i => z (.inr i)
   108	
   109	/-- The integer-coordinate map `χ` from the fixed field representation.  This
   110	is `eq:chi-func` in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   111	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   112	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   113	-/
   114	noncomputable def chiIndex (P : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ P) : Fin P.m := by
   115	  letI : NeZero P.m := ⟨by
   116	    exact Nat.ne_of_gt (lt_of_lt_of_le Nat.zero_lt_one P.hm)⟩
   117	  exact Fin.ofNat P.m ((binaryRepresentation P.model s).val / (P.q / P.m))
   118	
   119	/-- The projection used in the diagonal-line map zeroes coordinates before the
   120	chosen index and retains the suffix of the direction vector.  This is the
   121	prefix restriction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   122	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   123	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   124	-/
   125	def prefixProjection {P : LdParams} (i : Fin P.m) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   126	    Fin P.m → ScalarQ P :=
   127	  fun j => if j.val < i.val then 0 else v j
   128	
   129	/-- The point CL map, retaining the point block and clearing the auxiliary
   130	blocks.  It is the map `L_point` of `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   131	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   132	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   133	-/
   134	def ldPointCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   135	  fun i => match i with
   136	  | .inl (.inl j) => z (.inl (.inl j))
   137	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   138	  | .inr _ => 0
   139	
   140	/-- The affine-line CL map.  The direction block is put through the canonical
   141	line representative map from `def:line-representative`, while the point block
   142	is retained (blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper
   143	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   144	-/
   145	noncomputable def ldALineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   146	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   147	  let rep := lineRepMap (coordinateDirection i)
   148	  fun i => match i with
   149	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   150	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   151	  | .inr _ => 0
   152	
   153	/-- The diagonal-line CL map, using the same canonical representative interface
   154	for the direction block.  This is the `L_DLine` clause of
   155	`def:ld-question-distribution` (blueprint
   156	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper origin
   157	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   158	-/
   159	noncomputable def ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) (z : LdSpace P) : LdSpace P :=
   160	  let i := chiIndex P (z.seed)
   161	  let direction := prefixProjection i (z.direction)
   162	  let rep := lineRepMap direction
   163	  fun i => match i with
   164	  | .inl (.inl j) => (rep (z.point)) j
   165	  | .inl (.inr _) => z (.inl (.inr ()))
   166	  | .inr j => direction j
   167	
   168	/-- Dispatch the three low-degree CL maps by question type.  This is the typed
   169	construction in `def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   170	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   171	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   172	-/
   173	noncomputable def ldCL (P : LdParams) : LdType → LdSpace P → LdSpace P
   174	  | .point => ldPointCL P
   175	  | .aline => ldALineCL P
   176	  | .dline => ldDLineCL P
   177	
   178	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the shared scalar
   179	coordinate of the ambient low-degree space.  It is the first register in the
   180	concatenation exhibiting the conditional-linearity levels asserted in
   181	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint
   182	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper origin
   183	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   184	private def ldSeedRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   185	  {Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())}
   186	
   187	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the point coordinates
   188	of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   189	private def ldPointRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   190	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P)
   191	
   192	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the register carrying the direction
   193	coordinates of the ambient low-degree space; see `ldSeedRegister`. -/
   194	private def ldDirectionRegister (P : LdParams) : Finset (LdIndex P) :=
   195	  Finset.univ.image fun j : Fin P.m => (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P)
   196	
   197	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map retaining the shared scalar
   198	coordinate and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   199	private def ldSeedLinear (P : LdParams) :
   200	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   201	  toFun x := fun i =>
   202	    match i with
   203	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   204	    | .inl (.inr _) => x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   205	    | .inr _ => 0
   206	  map_add' x y := by
   207	    funext i
   208	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   209	  map_smul' c x := by
   210	    funext i
   211	    rcases i with (j | u) | j <;> simp
   212	
   213	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map sending the point block to its
   214	canonical line representative in the fixed direction `v` and clearing every
   215	other coordinate. -/
   216	private noncomputable def ldPointCLLinear (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   217	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   218	  toFun x := fun i =>
   219	    match i with
   220	    | .inl (.inl j) => lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point x) j
   221	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   222	    | .inr _ => 0
   223	  map_add' x y := by
   224	    funext i
   225	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   226	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (x + y)) j = _
   227	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (x + y) = LdSpace.point x + LdSpace.point y := rfl
   228	      rw [hpoint, map_add]
   229	      rfl
   230	    · simp
   231	    · simp
   232	  map_smul' c x := by
   233	    funext i
   234	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
   235	    · change lineRepMap v (LdSpace.point (c • x)) j = _
   236	      have hpoint : LdSpace.point (c • x) = c • LdSpace.point x := rfl
   237	      rw [hpoint, map_smul]
   238	      rfl
   239	    · simp
   240	    · simp
   241	
   242	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: the linear map zeroing the first `i`
   243	coordinates of the direction block and clearing every other coordinate. -/
   244	private def ldDirectionCLLinear (P : LdParams) (i : Fin P.m) :
   245	    LdSpace P →ₗ[ScalarQ P] LdSpace P where
   246	  toFun x := fun k =>
   247	    match k with
   248	    | .inl (.inl _) => 0
   249	    | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   250	    | .inr j => prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
   251	  map_add' x y := by
   252	    funext k
   253	    rcases k with (j | u) | j
   254	    · simp
   255	    · simp
   256	    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (x + y)) j =
   257	        prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j +
   258	          prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction y) j
   259	      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
   260	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, add_zero]
   261	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
   262	        rfl
   263	  map_smul' c x := by
   264	    funext k
   265	    rcases k with (j | u) | j
   266	    · simp
   267	    · simp
   268	    · change prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction (c • x)) j =
   269	        c • prefixProjection i (LdSpace.direction x) j
   270	      by_cases h : j.val < i.val
   271	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_pos h, smul_zero]
   272	      · simp only [prefixProjection, if_neg h]
   273	        rfl

   275	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the shared-scalar map vanishes
   276	outside the scalar register. -/
   277	private theorem ldSeedLinear_supported (P : LdParams) :
   278	    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldSeedRegister P →
   279	      ldSeedLinear P x i = 0 := by
   280	  intro x i hi
   281	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   282	  · rfl
   283	  · cases u
   284	    exact absurd (Finset.mem_singleton_self _) hi
   285	  · rfl
   286	
   287	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the canonical-representative map
   288	vanishes outside the point register. -/
   289	private theorem ldPointCLLinear_supported (P : LdParams) (v : Fin P.m → ScalarQ P) :
   290	    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (i : LdIndex P), i ∉ ldPointRegister P →
   291	      ldPointCLLinear P v x i = 0 := by
   292	  intro x i hi
   293	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   294	  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hi
   295	  · rfl
   296	  · rfl

   298	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the prefix-zeroing map vanishes
   299	outside the direction register. -/

   301	    ∀ (x : LdSpace P) (k : LdIndex P), k ∉ ldDirectionRegister P →
   302	      ldDirectionCLLinear P i x k = 0 := by
   303	  intro x k hk
   304	  rcases k with (j | u) | j
   305	  · rfl
   306	  · rfl
   307	  · exact absurd (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)) hk
   308	
   309	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the point register is disjoint from
   310	the scalar register. -/
   311	private theorem ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed (P : LdParams) :
   312	    ldPointRegister P ⊆ Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P := by
   313	  intro i hi
   314	  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
   315	  simp [ldSeedRegister]
   316	
   317	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the direction register is disjoint
   318	from the scalar register. -/
   319	private theorem ldDirectionRegister_subset_sdiff_seed (P : LdParams) :
   320	    ldDirectionRegister P ⊆ Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P := by
   321	  intro i hi
   322	  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi
   323	  simp [ldSeedRegister]

   325	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: the point register is disjoint from
   326	both the scalar and the direction registers. -/
   327	private theorem ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed_direction (P : LdParams) :
   328	    ldPointRegister P ⊆
   329	      (Finset.univ \ ldSeedRegister P) \ ldDirectionRegister P := by
   330	  intro i hi
   331	  obtain ⟨j, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hi

   334	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the scalar register
   335	leaves the shared scalar coordinate unchanged. -/
   336	private theorem coordinateRestriction_seed (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
   337	    coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) =
   338	      x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) := by
   339	  have hmem : (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()) : LdIndex P) ∈ ldSeedRegister P :=
   340	    Finset.mem_singleton_self _
   341	  simp [coordinateRestriction, hmem]
   342	
   343	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the point register
   344	leaves the point block unchanged. -/
   345	private theorem coordinateRestriction_point (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
   346	    LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) = LdSpace.point x := by
   347	  funext j
   348	  have hmem : (Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) : LdIndex P) ∈ ldPointRegister P :=
   349	    Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
   350	  simp [LdSpace.point, coordinateRestriction, hmem]
   351	
   352	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: restricting to the direction register
   353	leaves the direction block unchanged. -/
   354	private theorem coordinateRestriction_direction (P : LdParams) (x : LdSpace P) :
   355	    LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) =
   356	      LdSpace.direction x := by
   357	  funext j
   358	  have hmem : (Sum.inr j : LdIndex P) ∈ ldDirectionRegister P :=
   359	    Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)
   360	  simp [LdSpace.direction, coordinateRestriction, hmem]
   361	
   362	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a two-level representation of the
   363	affine-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
   364	private noncomputable def ldALineTerm (P : LdParams) :
   365	    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 2 :=
   366	  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
   367	    fun y =>
   368	      .succ (ldPointRegister P)
   369	        (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y))))
   370	        (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
   371	        fun _ => .zero
   372	
   373	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary: a three-level representation of the
   374	diagonal-line map as a conditionally linear function. -/
   375	private noncomputable def ldDLineTerm (P : LdParams) :
   376	    CondLinearTerm (ScalarQ P) (ι := LdIndex P) 3 :=
   377	  .succ (ldSeedRegister P) (ldSeedLinear P) (ldSeedLinear_supported P)
   378	    fun y =>
   379	      .succ (ldDirectionRegister P)
   380	        (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed y)))
   381	        (ldDirectionCLLinear_supported P _)
   382	        fun w =>
   383	          .succ (ldPointRegister P)
   384	            (ldPointCLLinear P (LdSpace.direction w))
   385	            (ldPointCLLinear_supported P _)
   386	            fun _ => .zero
   387	
   388	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the affine-line map.  This is
   389	`lem:ld-aline-level`, the level-2 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
   390	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:61-71`, paper
   391	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   392	-/
   393	theorem isCondLinear_ldALineCL (P : LdParams) :
   394	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 2 (ldALineCL P) := by
   395	  refine ⟨ldALineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
   396	    ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   397	  funext x
   398	  have hseed :
   399	      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
   400	        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
   401	  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
   402	      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
   403	  have hval :
   404	      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldALineTerm P) x =
   405	        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   406	          (ldPointCLLinear P (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   407	            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) := by
   408	    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   409	        (ldPointCLLinear P
   410	            (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P
   411	              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)))))
   412	            (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0) = _
   413	    rw [hseed]
   414	  rw [hval]
   415	  funext i
   416	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   417	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) +
   418	        (lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   419	          (LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x)) j + 0) =
   420	      lineRepMap (coordinateDirection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)))
   421	        (LdSpace.point x) j
   422	    rw [hpoint, zero_add, add_zero]
   423	  · change coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) +
   424	        ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   425	    rw [coordinateRestriction_seed, add_zero, add_zero]
   426	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0) = 0
   427	    rw [add_zero, add_zero]
   428	
   429	/-- The conditional-linearity level of the diagonal-line map.  This is
   430	`lem:ld-dline-level`, the level-3 assertion in `def:ld-question-distribution`;
   431	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:73-83`, paper origin
   432	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   433	-/
   434	theorem isCondLinear_ldDLineCL (P : LdParams) :
   435	    IsCondLinearOn (ScalarQ P) Finset.univ 3 (ldDLineCL P) := by
   436	  refine ⟨ldDLineTerm P, ⟨Finset.subset_univ _, fun _ =>
   437	    ⟨ldDirectionRegister_subset_sdiff_seed P, fun _ =>
   438	      ⟨ldPointRegister_subset_sdiff_seed_direction P, fun _ => trivial⟩⟩⟩, ?_⟩
   439	  funext x
   440	  have hseed :
   441	      LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x)) =
   442	        LdSpace.seed x := coordinateRestriction_seed P x
   443	  have hpoint : LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) =
   444	      LdSpace.point x := coordinateRestriction_point P x
   445	  have hdir :
   446	      LdSpace.direction
   447	          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   448	            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) =
   449	        prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x) := by
   450	    funext j
   451	    change prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   452	        (LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) j = _
   453	    rw [coordinateRestriction_direction]
   454	  have hval :
   455	      CondLinearTerm.eval (ldDLineTerm P) x =
   456	        ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   457	          (ldDirectionCLLinear P (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   458	              (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
   459	            (ldPointCLLinear P
   460	                (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
   461	                (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) := by
   462	    change ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x) +
   463	        (ldDirectionCLLinear P
   464	            (chiIndex P
   465	              (LdSpace.seed (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
   466	            (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x) +
   467	          (ldPointCLLinear P
   468	              (LdSpace.direction
   469	                (ldDirectionCLLinear P
   470	                  (chiIndex P
   471	                    (LdSpace.seed
   472	                      (ldSeedLinear P (coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x))))
   473	                  (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)))
   474	              (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x) + 0)) = _
   475	    rw [hseed, hdir]
   476	  rw [hval]
   477	  funext i
   478	  rcases i with (j | u) | j
   479	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) +
   480	        (lineRepMap
   481	          (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
   482	          (LdSpace.point (coordinateRestriction (ldPointRegister P) x)) j + 0)) =
   483	      lineRepMap (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x))
   484	        (LdSpace.point x) j
   485	    rw [hpoint, zero_add, zero_add, add_zero]
   486	  · change coordinateRestriction (ldSeedRegister P) x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) +
   487	        ((0 : ScalarQ P) + ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0)) = x (Sum.inl (Sum.inr ()))
   488	    rw [coordinateRestriction_seed, add_zero, add_zero, add_zero]
   489	  · change (0 : ScalarQ P) +
   490	        (prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x))
   491	            (LdSpace.direction (coordinateRestriction (ldDirectionRegister P) x)) j +
   492	          ((0 : ScalarQ P) + 0)) =
   493	      prefixProjection (chiIndex P (LdSpace.seed x)) (LdSpace.direction x) j
   494	    rw [coordinateRestriction_direction, zero_add, add_zero, add_zero]

   496	/-- The question alphabet for the low-degree game (`def:ld-game`, blueprint
   497	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-32`; paper origin
   498	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   499	-/
   500	abbrev LdQuestion (P : LdParams) := LdType × LdSpace P
   501	
   502	/-- The typed CL question distribution.  This is the inlined construction in
   503	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`; paper
   504	origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   505	-/
   506	noncomputable def ldQuestionDistribution (P : LdParams) :
   507	    Distribution (LdQuestion P × LdQuestion P) :=
   508	  Distribution.map
   509	    (uniformDistribution ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P))
   510	    (fun s =>
   511	      ((s.1.1, ldCL P s.1.1 s.2), (s.1.2, ldCL P s.1.2 s.2)))
   512	
   513	/-- The coefficient-tuple answer alphabet of the low-degree game.  Polynomial
   514	answers are representatives with exactly the coefficient lengths printed in
   515	the paper, as required by `def:ld-win-predicate` (blueprint
   516	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`; paper
   517	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   518	-/
   519	inductive LdAnswer (P : LdParams) where
   520	  | pointVals (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P)
   521	  | alinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   522	  | dlinePolys (a : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   523	  deriving DecidableEq
   524	
   525	/-- A finite sum code used only to provide the answer alphabet's `Fintype`
   526	instance; the public constructors are those of `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   527	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   528	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   529	-/
   530	abbrev LdAnswerCode (P : LdParams) :=
   531	  (Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   532	    ((Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P) ⊕
   533	      (Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P))
   534	
   535	/-- The constructor-preserving code equivalence for `LdAnswer` (Lean-only
   536	finite-carrier infrastructure for `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   537	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   538	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`).
   539	-/
   540	noncomputable def ldAnswerEquiv (P : LdParams) :
   541	    LdAnswer P ≃ LdAnswerCode P where
   542	  toFun
   543	    | .pointVals a => .inl a
   544	    | .alinePolys a => .inr (.inl a)
   545	    | .dlinePolys a => .inr (.inr a)
   546	  invFun
   547	    | .inl a => .pointVals a
   548	    | .inr (.inl a) => .alinePolys a
   549	    | .inr (.inr a) => .dlinePolys a
   550	  left_inv := by intro x; cases x <;> rfl
   551	  right_inv := by
   552	    intro x
   553	    cases x with
   554	    | inl a => rfl
   555	    | inr x =>
   556	        cases x with
   557	        | inl a => rfl
   558	        | inr a => rfl
   559	
   560	instance (P : LdParams) : Inhabited (LdAnswer P) :=
   561	  ⟨.pointVals (fun _ => 0)⟩
   562	
   563	noncomputable instance (P : LdParams) : Fintype (LdAnswer P) :=
   564	  Fintype.ofEquiv (LdAnswerCode P) (ldAnswerEquiv P).symm
   565	
   566	/-- Evaluation of a coefficient tuple at a field element.  This is the
   567	representative convention used by the line answers in `def:ld-win-predicate`,
   568	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   569	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   570	-/
   571	def evalCoefficient {K : Type*} [Semiring K] {n : ℕ}
   572	    (c : Fin n → K) (t : K) : K :=
   573	  ∑ i : Fin n, c i * t ^ i.val
   574	
   575	/-- Check that an answer has the constructor prescribed by its question type;
   576	Lean encoding of the rejection clause in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   577	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   578	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   579	-/
   580	def validLdAnswer {P : LdParams} (t : LdType) (a : LdAnswer P) : Bool :=
   581	  match t, a with
   582	  | .point, .pointVals _ => true
   583	  | .aline, .alinePolys _ => true
   584	  | .dline, .dlinePolys _ => true
   585	  | _, _ => false
   586	
   587	/-- The axis-parallel line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   588	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   589	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   590	-/
   591	def alinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   592	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   593	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   594	  -- Universal quantification follows the zero-direction convention in
   595	  -- `rem:ld-win-zero-direction`.
   596	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   597	    point.point = line.point + t • coordinateDirection (chiIndex P line.seed) →
   598	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   599	
   600	/-- The diagonal line/point relation in `def:ld-win-predicate`, blueprint
   601	`ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   602	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   603	-/
   604	def dlinePointCondition (P : LdParams) (line point : LdSpace P)
   605	    (f : Fin P.k → Fin (P.m * P.d + 1) → ScalarQ P)
   606	    (a : Fin P.k → ScalarQ P) : Prop :=
   607	  ∀ t : ScalarQ P,
   608	    point.point = line.point + t • line.direction →
   609	      ∀ j : Fin P.k, evalCoefficient (f j) t = a j
   610	
   611	/-- The low-degree consistency predicate, rejecting answers of the wrong
   612	constructor shape.  This is `def:ld-win-predicate` in
   613	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:137-156`, paper origin
   614	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   615	-/
   616	noncomputable def ldWinPredicate (P : LdParams) :
   617	    LdQuestion P → LdQuestion P → LdAnswer P → LdAnswer P → Bool :=
   618	  open Classical in
   619	  fun (tA, xA) (tB, xB) a b =>
   620	      if validLdAnswer tA a && validLdAnswer tB b then
   621	        match tA, tB, a, b with
   622	        | .point, .point, .pointVals u, .pointVals v => decide (u = v)
   623	        | .aline, .point, .alinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   624	            decide (alinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   625	        | .point, .aline, .pointVals u, .alinePolys f =>
   626	            decide (alinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   627	        | .dline, .point, .dlinePolys f, .pointVals u =>
   628	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xA xB f u)
   629	        | .point, .dline, .pointVals u, .dlinePolys f =>
   630	            decide (dlinePointCondition P xB xA f u)
   631	        | .aline, .aline, .alinePolys f, .alinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   632	        | .dline, .dline, .dlinePolys f, .dlinePolys g => decide (f = g)
   633	        | _, _, _, _ => true
   634	      else false
   635	
   636	/-- The low-degree game packaged as a `Game`.  This is `def:ld-game` in
   637	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:17-156`, paper origin
   638	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`.
   639	-/
   640	noncomputable def ldGame (P : LdParams) : Game where
   641	  QuestionA := LdQuestion P
   642	  QuestionB := LdQuestion P
   643	  AnswerA := LdAnswer P
   644	  AnswerB := LdAnswer P
   645	  μ := ldQuestionDistribution P
   646	  μ_prob := by
   647	    exact Distribution.IsProbability.map
   648	      (uniformDistribution_isProbability ((LdType × LdType) × LdSpace P)) _
   649	  decide := ldWinPredicate P
   650	
   651	end

     4	# Conditionally linear functions and graph distributions
     5	
     6	The question distributions in the Pauli basis test are generated by a finite
     7	graph of types and a shared seed, with each type applying a conditionally linear
     8	map to that seed.  The inductive predicate below records the level structure
     9	needed by later formalization stages.  The coordinate direct-sum development
    10	built on that predicate lives in
    11	`MIPStarRE/QPBT/Games/CondLinearTheorems/DirectSumSupport.lean`.
    12	
    13	## References
    14	
    15	The source-facing nodes are `def:cl-func`
    16	(`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`), `def:cl-dist`
    17	(`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1182-1185`), `lem:cl-concat`
    18	(`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1218-1232`), and `def:graph-distribution`
    19	(`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1348-1360`).
    20	The paper origins are
    21	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57,282-314`,
    22	`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:65-82`,
    23	and `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:964-1010`.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	open scoped BigOperators
    27	
    28	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    29	
    30	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    31	
    32	variable {K ι : Type*} [Field K] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    33	
    34	/--
    35	The source definition is recursive in the residual map.  A direct inductive
    36	predicate with that recursive occurrence under a dependent finite-set index is
    37	rejected by Lean's strict-positivity checker.  We therefore expose the same
    38	public predicate through a positive syntax tree (`CondLinearTerm`), together
    39	with its support invariant and evaluation function.  This is a representation
    40	deviation forced by Lean, not an additional mathematical hypothesis.  It encodes
    41	`def:cl-func`, blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`,
    42	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
    43	-/
    44	inductive CondLinearTerm (K : Type*) [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    45	    [DecidableEq ι] : ℕ → Type _ where
    46	  | zero : CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) 0
    47	  | succ {ell : ℕ}
    48	      (S₁ : Finset ι)
    49	      (L₁ : (ι → K) →ₗ[K] (ι → K))
    50	      (hSupport : ∀ x i, i ∉ S₁ → L₁ x i = 0)
    51	      (rest : (ι → K) → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell) :
    52	      CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) (ell + 1)
    53	
    54	/-- Restrict a coordinate vector to a register, zeroing the complementary
    55	coordinates.  This is Lean-only support for the projections in `def:cl-func`,
    56	blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`, paper origin
    57	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
    58	-/
    59	def coordinateRestriction (S : Finset ι) (x : ι → K) : ι → K :=
    60	  fun i => if i ∈ S then x i else 0
    61	
    62	/-- Evaluation of a representation of a conditionally linear function.
    63	Lean-only support for `def:cl-func`, blueprint
    64	`ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`, paper origin
    65	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
    66	-/
    67	def CondLinearTerm.eval {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    68	    {K : Type*} [Field K] :
    69	    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell → (ι → K) → (ι → K)
    70	  | _, .zero => fun _ => 0
    71	  | _, .succ S₁ L₁ _ rest =>
    72	      fun x =>
    73	        let x₁ := coordinateRestriction S₁ x
    74	        L₁ x₁ + CondLinearTerm.eval (rest (L₁ x₁)) x
    75	
    76	/-- The support invariant for a representation of a conditionally linear
    77	function.  This is a Lean-only companion to `def:cl-func`, blueprint
    78	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`, paper origin
    79	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
    80	-/
    81	def CondLinearTerm.supportedOn {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
    82	    {K : Type*} [Field K] :
    83	    {ell : ℕ} → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell → Finset ι → Prop
    84	  | _, .zero, _ => True
    85	  | _, .succ S₁ _ _ rest, S =>
    86	      S₁ ⊆ S ∧ ∀ y, CondLinearTerm.supportedOn (rest y) (S \ S₁)
    87	
    88	/-- The public conditionally-linear predicate.  Its positive syntax-tree
    89	encoding is the Lean representation of `def:cl-func`, blueprint
    90	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`, paper origin
    91	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
    92	-/
    93	def IsCondLinearOn (K : Type*) [Field K] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    94	    [DecidableEq ι] (S : Finset ι) (ell : ℕ)
    95	    (L : (ι → K) → (ι → K)) : Prop :=
    96	  ∃ t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell,
    97	    CondLinearTerm.supportedOn t S ∧ CondLinearTerm.eval t = L
    98	
    99	/--
   100	`IsCondLinear` abbreviates the full-coordinate predicate.  Blueprint
   101	`def:cl-func`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1168-1178`; paper
   102	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:35-57`.
   103	-/
   104	def IsCondLinear (ell : ℕ) (L : (ι → K) → (ι → K)) : Prop :=
   105	  IsCondLinearOn K Finset.univ ell L
   106	
   107	/-- The zero conditionally linear function at every level, used to extend the
   108	family `R u` from the image `L(U)` to all indices in the concatenation
   109	construction of `lem:cl-concat`. -/
   110	private def CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   111	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] : (ell : ℕ) → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell
   112	  | 0 => .zero
   113	  | ell + 1 => .succ ∅ 0 (by simp) (fun _ => zeroOfLevel ell)
   114	
   115	@[simp]
   116	private theorem CondLinearTerm.eval_zeroOfLevel {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   117	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (ell : ℕ) (x : ι → K) :
   118	    CondLinearTerm.eval (CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel (K := K) (ι := ι) ell) x = 0 := by
   119	  induction ell with
   120	  | zero => rfl
   121	  | succ ell ih =>
   122	      simp [CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel, CondLinearTerm.eval, ih]
   123	
   124	private theorem CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel_supportedOn {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   125	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (ell : ℕ) (S : Finset ι) :
   126	    CondLinearTerm.supportedOn
   127	      (CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel (K := K) (ι := ι) ell) S := by
   128	  induction ell generalizing S with
   129	  | zero => trivial
   130	  | succ ell ih =>
   131	      exact ⟨by simp, fun _ => ih _⟩
   132	
   133	/-- Extending the support set preserves the support invariant. -/
   134	private theorem CondLinearTerm.supportedOn_mono {K ι : Type*} [Field K]
   135	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {ell : ℕ}
   136	    {t : CondLinearTerm K (ι := ι) ell} {S T : Finset ι}
   137	    (ht : CondLinearTerm.supportedOn t S) (hST : S ⊆ T) :
   138	    CondLinearTerm.supportedOn t T := by
   139	  induction t generalizing S T with
   140	  | zero => trivial
   280	  induction t generalizing acc SU with
   281	  | zero =>
   282	      exact CondLinearTerm.supportedOn_mono
   283	        (CondLinearTerm.liftRight_supportedOn (hr acc)) Finset.subset_union_right
   284	  | @succ k S₁ L₁ hSupport rest ih =>
   285	      rcases ht with ⟨hS₁, hrest⟩
   286	      refine ⟨(Finset.map_subset_map.mpr hS₁).trans Finset.subset_union_left,
   287	        fun y => ?_⟩
   288	      have hrec := ih (fun i => y (.inl i)) (acc := acc + fun i => y (.inl i))
   289	        (hrest (fun i => y (.inl i)))
   290	      have hsets :
   291	          (SU \ S₁).map Function.Embedding.inl ∪ SV.map Function.Embedding.inr =
   292	            (SU.map Function.Embedding.inl ∪ SV.map Function.Embedding.inr) \
   293	              S₁.map Function.Embedding.inl := by
   294	        ext i
   295	        cases i <;> simp
   296	      simpa only [hsets] using hrec
   297	
   298	/--
   299	The distribution obtained by applying two conditionally linear maps to a common
   300	uniform seed.  This is `def:cl-dist` in
   301	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1182-1185`, paper origin
   302	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:132-138`.
   303	-/
   304	noncomputable def clDistribution [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
   305	    (L R : (ι → K) → (ι → K)) :
   306	    Distribution ((ι → K) × (ι → K)) :=
   307	  (uniformDistribution (ι → K)).map (fun z => (L z, R z))
   308	
   309	/-- The direct-sum map used to encode the paper's CL concatenation.  The left
   310	coordinates carry `L`, while the right coordinates carry the family member
   311	`R u v` selected by the left input `u`.  This is Lean-only coordinate
   312	infrastructure for `lem:cl-concat`, blueprint
   313	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1218-1232`, paper origin
   314	`references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:282-314`.
   315	-/
   316	def condLinearConcat {ιU ιV : Type*} [Fintype ιU] [DecidableEq ιU]
   317	    [Fintype ιV] [DecidableEq ιV] (L : (ιU → K) → (ιU → K))
   318	    (R : (ιU → K) → (ιV → K) → (ιV → K))
   319	    (x : ιU ⊕ ιV → K) : ιU ⊕ ιV → K :=
   320	  let u : ιU → K := fun i => x (.inl i)
   321	  let v : ιV → K := fun j => x (.inr j)
   322	  Sum.elim (L u) (R (L u) v)
   323	
   324	/--
   325	Concatenating an outer and an indexed inner CL map adds their levels.  This is
   326	`lem:cl-concat` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1218-1232`, with
   327	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/05_conditionally_linear_functions.tex:282-314`.
   328	The map `condLinearConcat` realizes this concatenation on the direct sum.
   329	-/
   330	theorem IsCondLinearOn.concat {ιU ιV : Type*} [Fintype ιU] [DecidableEq ιU]
   331	    [Fintype ιV] [DecidableEq ιV] {ell k : ℕ}
   332	    {L : (ιU → K) → (ιU → K)}
   333	    {R : (ιU → K) → (ιV → K) → (ιV → K)}
   334	    (hL : IsCondLinearOn K (Finset.univ : Finset ιU) k L)
   335	    (hR : ∀ u : ιU → K, u ∈ Set.range L →
   336	      IsCondLinearOn K (Finset.univ : Finset ιV) ell (R u)) :
   337	    IsCondLinearOn K (Finset.univ : Finset (ιU ⊕ ιV)) (k + ell)
   338	      (condLinearConcat L R) := by
   339	  classical
   340	  rcases hL with ⟨tL, htL, htL_eval⟩
   341	  let rTerm : (ιU → K) → CondLinearTerm K (ι := ιV) ell := fun u =>
   342	    if hu : u ∈ Set.range L then Classical.choose (hR u hu)
   343	    else CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel ell
   344	  have hr_supported (u : ιU → K) :
   345	      CondLinearTerm.supportedOn (rTerm u) (Finset.univ : Finset ιV) := by
   346	    by_cases hu : u ∈ Set.range L
   347	    · simp only [rTerm, dif_pos hu]
   348	      exact (Classical.choose_spec (hR u hu)).1
   349	    · simp only [rTerm, dif_neg hu]
   350	      exact CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel_supportedOn ell Finset.univ
   351	  have hr_eval (u : ιU → K) (hu : u ∈ Set.range L) :
   352	      CondLinearTerm.eval (rTerm u) = R u := by
   353	    simp only [rTerm, dif_pos hu]
   354	    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hR u hu)).2
   355	  rw [Nat.add_comm k ell]
   356	  refine ⟨CondLinearTerm.concat rTerm 0 tL, ?_, ?_⟩
   357	  · have hsupport := CondLinearTerm.concat_supportedOn
   358	      (acc := (0 : ιU → K)) htL hr_supported
   359	    have huniv :
   360	        (Finset.univ : Finset ιU).map Function.Embedding.inl ∪
   361	            (Finset.univ : Finset ιV).map Function.Embedding.inr =
   362	          (Finset.univ : Finset (ιU ⊕ ιV)) := by
   363	      ext i
   364	      cases i <;> simp
   365	    simpa only [huniv] using hsupport
   366	  · funext x
   367	    rw [CondLinearTerm.eval_concat]
   368	    simp only [zero_add]
   369	    rw [congrFun htL_eval (fun i => x (.inl i))]
   370	    rw [hr_eval (L (fun i => x (.inl i))) ⟨_, rfl⟩]
   371	    rfl
   372	
   373	/--
   374	The graph distribution is uniform on ordered pairs `(a, b)` whose unordered
   375	pair belongs to `E`, including self-loops.  This is `def:graph-distribution`
   376	in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1348-1360`;
   377	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:984-1009`.
   378	The underlying graph-distribution definition is
   379	`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:65-82`.
   380	-/
   381	noncomputable def graphDistribution {T : Type*} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
   382	    (E : Finset (Sym2 T)) (_hE : E.Nonempty) : Distribution (T × T) :=
   383	  Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   384	    (Finset.univ.filter fun ab : T × T => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ E)
   385	
   386	/-- The graph distribution has total mass one whenever its edge set is
   387	nonempty.  This is not a named statement of the source article; it is
   388	`lem:graph-distribution-mass` in
   389	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1362-1372`. -/
   390	theorem graphDistribution_isProbability {T : Type*} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]

     3	/-!
     4	# Lines and canonical representatives
     5	
     6	The classical and Pauli question distributions use affine lines in a finite
     7	coordinate space.  This module keeps the zero-direction case explicit and
     8	provides the canonical projection used for line representatives.
     9	
    10	## References
    11	
    12	The source-facing nodes are `def:line`, `prop:line-equiv`, and
    13	`def:line-representative` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:464-520`;
    14	the formalization support nodes `lem:line-rep-kernel` and
    15	`lem:line-rep-incidence` are at `ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:522-550`.
    16	The paper origin is `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:102-174`.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    20	
    21	open scoped BigOperators
    22	
    23	variable {K : Type*} [Field K]
    24	
    25	/--
    26	The affine line through `u` in direction `v`, including the singleton case
    27	`v = 0`.  Blueprint `def:line`, `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:464-478`;
    28	paper origin
    29	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:106-124`.
    30	-/
    31	def linePoints {m : ℕ}
    32	    (u v : Fin m → K) : Set (Fin m → K) :=
    33	  {x | ∃ t : K, x = u + t • v}
    34	
    35	/-- The elementary coordinate direction used in the axis-parallel predicate of
    36	`def:line`; blueprint `ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:464-478`, paper origin
    37	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:106-124`.
    38	-/
    39	def coordinateDirection {m : ℕ}
    40	    (i : Fin m) : Fin m → K :=
    41	  Pi.single i 1
    42	
    43	/--
    44	`IsAxisParallel v` means that `v` is a standard coordinate direction.  This is
    45	the axis-parallel clause of `def:line` (blueprint lines 464-478; paper
    46	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:106-124`).
    47	-/
    48	def IsAxisParallel {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) : Prop :=
    49	  ∃ i : Fin m, v = coordinateDirection i
    50	
    51	/--
    52	The diagonal-direction predicate from `def:line`; a prefix of coordinates may
    53	vanish.  Blueprint `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:464-478`; paper origin
    54	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:106-124`.
    55	-/
    56	def IsDiagonal {m : ℕ} (v : Fin m → K) : Prop :=
    57	  ∃ i : Fin m, ∀ j : Fin m, j.1 < i.1 → v j = 0
    58	
    59	/--
    60	Changing the base point to another point on a line leaves the line unchanged.
    61	This is `prop:line-equiv` in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:480-486`,
    62	with paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:128-132`.
    63	-/
    64	theorem linePoints_eq_of_mem {m : ℕ}
    65	    (u v u' : Fin m → K) (h : u' ∈ linePoints u v) :
    66	    linePoints u v = linePoints u' v := by
    67	  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := h
    68	  ext x
    69	  constructor
    70	  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    71	    exact ⟨s - t, by module⟩
    72	  · rintro ⟨s, rfl⟩
    73	    exact ⟨t + s, by module⟩
    74	
    75	/--
    76	The canonical linear representative map of a line direction.  It projects onto
    77	the coordinate complement of the span of `v`; for `v = 0` the span is bottom,
    78	so the resulting map is the identity.  Blueprint `def:line-representative`,
    79	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:500-520`; paper origin
    80	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174`.
    81	-/
    82	noncomputable def lineRepMap {m : ℕ}
    83	    (v : Fin m → K) : (Fin m → K) →ₗ[K] (Fin m → K) :=
    84	  canonicalProjOfKernel (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K)))
    85	
    86	/- The point-valued companion to `lineRepMap`; Lean-only notation for the
    87	canonical representative in `def:line-representative`. -/
    88	/-- The canonical representative point `lineRepMap v u`.  Blueprint
    89	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:500-520`, paper origin
    90	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:166-174`.
    91	-/
    92	noncomputable def lineRep {m : ℕ}
    93	    (u v : Fin m → K) : Fin m → K :=
    94	  lineRepMap v u
    95	
    96	/--
    97	Formalization support node `lem:line-rep-kernel` for
    98	`def:line-representative` (blueprint
    99	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:522-530`, paper origin
   100	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:143-174`).
   101	The canonical representative map is a projection whose kernel is the line
   102	`K v`, so a point and its canonical representative differ by a scalar multiple
   103	of the direction.
   104	-/
   105	theorem sub_lineRepMap_mem_span {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
   106	    u - lineRepMap v u ∈ Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K)) := by
   107	  have hc :
   108	      IsCompl
   109	        (registerSubmodule K
   110	          (canonicalComplement (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K)))))
   111	        (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))) :=
   112	    (isCompl_registerSubmodule_canonicalComplement
   113	      (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K)))).symm
   114	  have hrep : lineRepMap v u =
   115	      (registerSubmodule K
   116	        (canonicalComplement (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))))).projection
   117	        (Submodule.span K ({v} : Set (Fin m → K))) hc u := rfl
   118	  rw [hrep, ← Submodule.projection_eq_self_sub_projection hc u]
   119	  exact Submodule.projection_apply_mem hc.symm u
   120	
   121	/--
   122	Formalization support node `lem:line-rep-incidence` for
   123	`def:line-representative` (blueprint
   124	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch11_qpbt_algebra.tex:537-545`, paper origin
   125	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:166-174`).
   126	Every point lies on the line through its own canonical representative in the
   127	same direction; this is the incidence property used by the line-versus-point
   128	samplers.
   129	-/
   130	theorem mem_linePoints_lineRepMap {m : ℕ} (v u : Fin m → K) :
   131	    u ∈ linePoints (lineRepMap v u) v := by
   132	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp (sub_lineRepMap_mem_span v u)
   133	  exact ⟨t, by rw [ht]; abel⟩
   134	
   135	end MIPStarRE.QPBT

    11	outcomes are bounded multivariate polynomials.

    13	## References

    16	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-202`. Their paper origin is
    17	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:243-287,392-480`.

    21	
    22	open scoped BigOperators
    23	
    24	namespace MIPStarRE.QPBT
    25	
    26	open MIPStarRE.LDT
    27	open MIPStarRE.LDT.Preliminaries
    28	open MIPStarRE.Quantum

    30	noncomputable section

    32	/-!
    33	### Formalization-only auxiliary facts about the ambient low-degree space
    34	-/
    35	
    36	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary equivalence splitting an ambient low-degree
    37	vector into its point, seed, and direction blocks. -/
    38	private def ldSpaceSplit (L : LdParams) :
    39	    LdSpace L ≃ ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) where
    40	  toFun z := ((LdSpace.point z, LdSpace.seed z), LdSpace.direction z)
    41	  invFun p := fun i =>
    42	    match i with
    43	    | .inl (.inl j) => p.1.1 j
    44	    | .inl (.inr _) => p.1.2
    45	    | .inr j => p.2 j
    46	  left_inv z := by
    47	    funext i
    48	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
    49	    · rfl
    50	    · cases u
    51	      rfl
    52	    · rfl
    53	  right_inv p := by
    54	    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, c⟩ := p
    55	    rfl

   113	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: every fiber of the coordinate index has
   114	exactly `q / m` elements.  This is the balance property used in
   115	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   117	private theorem card_chiIndex_fiber (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   118	    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   119	      = L.q / L.m := by
   120	  have hq : 0 < L.q := ldParams_q_pos L
   121	  have hqk : L.m * (L.q / L.m) = L.q := Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd
   122	  have hkpos : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   123	    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (L.q / L.m) with h | h
   124	    · rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at hqk
   125	      omega
   126	    · exact h
   127	  have hstep1 :
   128	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   129	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   130	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).card := by
   131	    refine Finset.card_equiv (binaryRepresentation L.model) fun s => ?_
   132	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, chiIndex_eq_iff]
   133	  have hstep2 :
   134	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   135	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   136	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).image Fin.val := by
   137	    ext t
   138	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image,
   139	      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   140	    constructor
   141	    · rintro ⟨ht, hP⟩
   142	      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hP, rfl⟩
   143	    · rintro ⟨n, hP, rfl⟩
   144	      exact ⟨n.isLt, hP⟩
   145	  have hstep3 :
   146	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   147	        = Finset.Ico (i.val * (L.q / L.m)) (i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m) := by
   148	    ext t
   149	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]
   150	    constructor
   151	    · rintro ⟨htq, hP⟩
   152	      have hlt : t / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
   153	        rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   154	        omega
   155	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   156	        rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hP
   157	      have hle : t / (L.q / L.m) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ t := Nat.div_mul_le_self t _
   158	      have hupper : t < (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) := by
   159	        rw [← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos, hdiv]
   160	        omega
   161	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   162	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   163	      rw [hdiv] at hle
   164	      omega
   165	    · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
   166	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   167	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   168	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   169	        have h1 : i.val ≤ t / (L.q / L.m) := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hkpos).mpr hlo
   170	        have h2 : t / (L.q / L.m) < i.val + 1 := by
   171	          rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   172	          omega
   173	        omega
   174	      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   175	      · have hbound : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   176	          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ i.isLt
   177	        omega
   178	      · rw [hdiv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt]
   179	  rw [hstep1, ← Finset.card_image_of_injective
   180	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   181	        fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val) Fin.val_injective,
   182	    ← hstep2, hstep3, Nat.card_Ico]
   183	  omega

     6	Typed question distributions first sample an ordered edge of the type graph and

    22	linear. This is `def:typed-cl-functions`, blueprint

    24	`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:57-63`. -/

    26	    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]

   350	      exact CondLinearTerm.zeroOfLevel_supportedOn ell Finset.univ
   351	  have hr_eval (u : ιU → K) (hu : u ∈ Set.range L) :
   352	      CondLinearTerm.eval (rTerm u) = R u := by
   353	    simp only [rTerm, dif_pos hu]
   354	    exact (Classical.choose_spec (hR u hu)).2
   355	  rw [Nat.add_comm k ell]
   356	  refine ⟨CondLinearTerm.concat rTerm 0 tL, ?_, ?_⟩
   357	  · have hsupport := CondLinearTerm.concat_supportedOn
   358	      (acc := (0 : ιU → K)) htL hr_supported
   359	    have huniv :
   360	        (Finset.univ : Finset ιU).map Function.Embedding.inl ∪
   361	            (Finset.univ : Finset ιV).map Function.Embedding.inr =
   362	          (Finset.univ : Finset (ιU ⊕ ιV)) := by
   363	      ext i
   364	      cases i <;> simp
   365	    simpa only [huniv] using hsupport
   366	  · funext x
   367	    rw [CondLinearTerm.eval_concat]
   368	    simp only [zero_add]
   369	    rw [congrFun htL_eval (fun i => x (.inl i))]
   370	    rw [hr_eval (L (fun i => x (.inl i))) ⟨_, rfl⟩]
   371	    rfl

   373	/--
   374	The graph distribution is uniform on ordered pairs `(a, b)` whose unordered
   375	pair belongs to `E`, including self-loops.  This is `def:graph-distribution`
   376	in `blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1348-1360`;
   377	paper origin `references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:984-1009`.
   378	The underlying graph-distribution definition is
   379	`references/qpbt-paper/07_types.tex:65-82`.
   380	-/
   381	noncomputable def graphDistribution {T : Type*} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
   382	    (E : Finset (Sym2 T)) (_hE : E.Nonempty) : Distribution (T × T) :=
   383	  Distribution.uniformOnFinset
   384	    (Finset.univ.filter fun ab : T × T => Sym2.mk ab.1 ab.2 ∈ E)
   385	
   386	/-- The graph distribution has total mass one whenever its edge set is
   387	nonempty.  This is not a named statement of the source article; it is
   388	`lem:graph-distribution-mass` in
   389	`blueprint/src/chapter/ch12_qpbt_games.tex:1362-1372`. -/
   390	theorem graphDistribution_isProbability {T : Type*} [Fintype T] [DecidableEq T]
   391	    (E : Finset (Sym2 T)) (hE : E.Nonempty) :
   392	    (graphDistribution E hE).IsProbability := by
   393	  apply Distribution.uniformOnFinset_isProbability
   394	  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hE
   395	  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, rfl⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e
   396	  change s(a, b) ∈ E at he
   397	  exact ⟨(a, b), Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, he⟩⟩

    36	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary equivalence splitting an ambient low-degree
    37	vector into its point, seed, and direction blocks. -/
    38	private def ldSpaceSplit (L : LdParams) :
    39	    LdSpace L ≃ ((Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) × ScalarQ L) × (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) where
    40	  toFun z := ((LdSpace.point z, LdSpace.seed z), LdSpace.direction z)
    41	  invFun p := fun i =>
    42	    match i with
    43	    | .inl (.inl j) => p.1.1 j
    44	    | .inl (.inr _) => p.1.2
    45	    | .inr j => p.2 j
    46	  left_inv z := by
    47	    funext i
    48	    rcases i with (j | u) | j
    49	    · rfl
    50	    · cases u
    51	      rfl
    52	    · rfl
    53	  right_inv p := by
    54	    obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, c⟩ := p
    55	    rfl

   100	private theorem ldParams_q_pos (L : LdParams) : 0 < L.q := by

   106	read off from its binary representation. -/
   107	private theorem chiIndex_eq_iff (L : LdParams) (s : ScalarQ L) (i : Fin L.m) :
   108	    chiIndex L s = i ↔
   109	      ((binaryRepresentation L.model s).val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val := by

   113	/-- Formalization-only auxiliary lemma: every fiber of the coordinate index has
   114	exactly `q / m` elements.  This is the balance property used in
   115	`def:ld-question-distribution`, blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:34-59`, paper
   116	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:31-391`. -/
   117	private theorem card_chiIndex_fiber (L : LdParams) (i : Fin L.m) :
   118	    ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   119	      = L.q / L.m := by
   120	  have hq : 0 < L.q := ldParams_q_pos L
   121	  have hqk : L.m * (L.q / L.m) = L.q := Nat.mul_div_cancel' L.hdvd
   122	  have hkpos : 0 < L.q / L.m := by
   123	    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (L.q / L.m) with h | h
   124	    · rw [h, Nat.mul_zero] at hqk
   125	      omega
   126	    · exact h
   127	  have hstep1 :
   128	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (ScalarQ L)).filter fun s => chiIndex L s = i).card
   129	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   130	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).card := by
   131	    refine Finset.card_equiv (binaryRepresentation L.model) fun s => ?_
   132	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, chiIndex_eq_iff]
   133	  have hstep2 :
   134	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   135	        = ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   136	            fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val).image Fin.val := by
   137	    ext t
   138	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_image,
   139	      Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
   140	    constructor
   141	    · rintro ⟨ht, hP⟩
   142	      exact ⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hP, rfl⟩
   143	    · rintro ⟨n, hP, rfl⟩
   144	      exact ⟨n.isLt, hP⟩
   145	  have hstep3 :
   146	      ((Finset.range L.q).filter fun t => (t / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val)
   147	        = Finset.Ico (i.val * (L.q / L.m)) (i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m) := by
   148	    ext t
   149	    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_Ico]
   150	    constructor
   151	    · rintro ⟨htq, hP⟩
   152	      have hlt : t / (L.q / L.m) < L.m := by
   153	        rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   154	        omega
   155	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   156	        rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt] at hP
   157	      have hle : t / (L.q / L.m) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ t := Nat.div_mul_le_self t _
   158	      have hupper : t < (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) := by
   159	        rw [← Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos, hdiv]
   160	        omega
   161	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   162	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   163	      rw [hdiv] at hle
   164	      omega
   165	    · rintro ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
   166	      have hexp : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m)
   167	          = i.val * (L.q / L.m) + L.q / L.m := by ring
   168	      have hdiv : t / (L.q / L.m) = i.val := by
   169	        have h1 : i.val ≤ t / (L.q / L.m) := (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le hkpos).mpr hlo
   170	        have h2 : t / (L.q / L.m) < i.val + 1 := by
   171	          rw [Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hkpos]
   172	          omega
   173	        omega
   174	      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
   175	      · have hbound : (i.val + 1) * (L.q / L.m) ≤ L.m * (L.q / L.m) :=
   176	          Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ i.isLt
   177	        omega
   178	      · rw [hdiv, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt i.isLt]
   179	  rw [hstep1, ← Finset.card_image_of_injective
   180	      ((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin L.q)).filter
   181	        fun n => (n.val / (L.q / L.m)) % L.m = i.val) Fin.val_injective,
   182	    ← hstep2, hstep3, Nat.card_Ico]
   183	  omega

   348	  have hright : ∀ hE : (Finset.univ : Finset (Sym2 LdType)).Nonempty,
   349	      typedCLDistribution (Finset.univ : Finset (Sym2 LdType)) hE (ldCL L) (ldCL L) =
   350	        Distribution.bind (uniformDistribution (LdType × LdType))
   351	          (fun uv => (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   352	            fun z => ((uv.1, ldCL L uv.1 z), (uv.2, ldCL L uv.2 z))) := by
   353	    intro hE
   354	    have hfamily : (fun uv : LdType × LdType =>
   355	        (clDistribution (ldCL L uv.1) (ldCL L uv.2)).map
   356	          fun xy => ((uv.1, xy.1), (uv.2, xy.2))) =
   357	      fun uv : LdType × LdType => (uniformDistribution (LdSpace L)).map
   358	        fun z => ((uv.1, ldCL L uv.1 z), (uv.2, ldCL L uv.2 z)) := by
   359	      funext uv
   360	      exact Distribution.map_map _ _ _
   361	    change Distribution.bind (graphDistribution _ hE) _ = _
   362	    rw [hgraph hE, hfamily]
   363	  rw [hleft, hright]
   364	
   365	/-- Bounded multivariate polynomials form a finite set over a finite coefficient
   366	semiring. This is the finite outcome set required by `def:ld-meas`,
   367	blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-171`, paper
   368	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
   369	noncomputable instance polyFuncFintype (m : ℕ) (K : Type*)
   370	    [CommSemiring K] [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) : Fintype ↥(polyFunc m K d) := by
   371	  letI : Finite ↥(polyFunc m K d) := Module.finite_of_finite K
   372	  exact Fintype.ofFinite _
   373	
   374	/-- A bounded multivariate polynomial outcome over an arbitrary finite
   375	coefficient semiring. -/
   376	noncomputable abbrev PolyIndex (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
   377	    [Fintype K] (d : ℕ) := ↥(polyFunc m K d)
   378	
   379	/-- A POVM indexed by one bounded multivariate polynomial. -/
   380	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeas (m : ℕ) (K : Type*) [CommSemiring K]
   381	    [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] (d : ℕ) (ι : Type*)
   382	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] := Measurement (PolyIndex m K d) ι
   383	
   384	/-- The dependent family in `def:ld-meas`: component `i` may
   385	have its own coefficient field, number of variables, and degree bound.
   386	Blueprint `ch13_qpbt_test.tex:164-171`, paper
   387	`08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:394-408`. -/
   388	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasFamily (k : ℕ) (K : Fin k → Type*)
   389	    [∀ i, CommSemiring (K i)] [∀ i, Fintype (K i)]
   390	    [∀ i, DecidableEq (K i)] (m d : Fin k → ℕ) (ι : Type*)
   391	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   392	  Measurement ((i : Fin k) → PolyIndex (m i) (K i) (d i)) ι
   393	
   394	/-- A simultaneous tuple of `L.k` bounded polynomial representatives. -/
   395	noncomputable abbrev PolyTuple (L : LdParams) :=
   396	  Fin L.k → PolyIndex L.m (ScalarQ L) L.d
   397	
   398	/-- The constant-family specialization used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
   399	noncomputable abbrev PolyMeasTuple (L : LdParams) (ι : Type*)
   400	    [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] :=
   401	  PolyMeasFamily L.k (fun _ => ScalarQ L) (fun _ => L.m) (fun _ => L.d) ι
   402	
   403	/-- Evaluate every component of a polynomial tuple at a point. -/
   404	def evalPolyTupleAt {L : LdParams} (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L)
   405	    (g : PolyTuple L) : Fin L.k → ScalarQ L :=
   406	  fun j => MvPolynomial.eval u (g j).1
   407	
   408	/-- Embed a geometric point into the ambient coefficient space used by a
   409	point question. -/
   410	def pointSpaceOf (L : LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) : LdSpace L :=
   411	  fun i => match i with
   412	  | .inl (.inl j) => u j
   413	  | .inl (.inr _) => 0
   414	  | .inr _ => 0
   415	
   416	/-- The typed low-degree point question associated with `u`. -/
   417	def ldPointQuestionOf (L : LdParams) (u : Fin L.m → ScalarQ L) : LdQuestion L :=
   418	  (.point, pointSpaceOf L u)
   419	
   420	/-- Read the point component of a low-degree answer, sending answers of the
   421	wrong form to the fixed zero tuple. This total relabeling turns the strategy's
   422	answer measurement into the point POVM used by `lem:ld-soundness`. -/
   423	def ldPointValuesOrZero (L : LdParams) : LdAnswer L → Fin L.k → ScalarQ L
   424	  | .pointVals values => values
   425	  | .alinePolys _ => 0
   426	  | .dlinePolys _ => 0
   427	
   428	/-- The quantitative error function in `lem:ld-soundness`.  Its argument order
   429	is `(a, b, ε, q, m, d, k)`. -/
   430	noncomputable def deltaLd (a b ε : ℝ) (q m d k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   431	  a * Real.rpow (((d * m * k : ℕ) : ℝ)) a *
   432	    (Real.rpow ε b + Real.rpow (q : ℝ) (-b) +
   433	      Real.rpow 2 (-(b * ((m * d : ℕ) : ℝ))))
   434	
   435	/-- Quantum soundness of the simultaneous classical low individual degree
   436	test (`lem:ld-soundness`, blueprint lines 135--160; paper theorem and proof
   437	`references/qpbt-paper/08_classical_and_quantum_low_degree_tests.tex:413-458`).
   438	
   439	The first two consistency bounds compare the point-answer postprocessing of the
   440	strategy with evaluations of the polynomial measurements. Answers of the wrong
   441	form are folded into the zero tuple so that the point family remains a POVM.
   442	
   443	The source reduction still requires proofs of the claimed game correspondence
   444	and of the auxiliary parameter bound. These two open facts are detailed in
   445	`docs/paper-gaps/qpbt_ld-dimension-divisibility.tex` and
   446	`rem:ld-soundness-provider`, and are tracked by issue #16. -/
   447	theorem exists_ld_soundness :
   448	    ∃ a b : ℝ, 1 ≤ a ∧ 0 < b ∧ b ≤ 1 ∧
   449	      ∀ (L : LdParams) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
   450	        ∀ S : Strategy (ldGame L), S.IsProjective → 1 - ε ≤ S.value →
   451	          ∃ GA : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιA, ∃ GB : PolyMeasTuple L S.ιB,
   452	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   453	                (fun u outcome =>
   454	                  heteroKron
   455	                    (((S.A (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   456	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome) 1)
   457	                (fun u outcome =>
   458	                  heteroKron 1
   459	                    ((GB.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome))
   460	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   461	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution (Fin L.m → ScalarQ L))
   462	                (fun u outcome =>
   463	                  heteroKron
   464	                    ((GA.postprocess (evalPolyTupleAt u)).effect outcome) 1)
   465	                (fun u outcome =>
   466	                  heteroKron 1
   467	                    (((S.B (ldPointQuestionOf L u)).postprocess
   468	                      (ldPointValuesOrZero L)).effect outcome))
   469	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k ∧
   470	            consistencyDefect (uniformDistribution Unit)
   471	                (fun _ g => heteroKron (GA.effect g) 1)
   472	                (fun _ g => heteroKron 1 (GB.effect g))
   473	                S.ψ ≤ deltaLd a b ε L.q L.m L.d L.k := by
   474	  sorry
   475	
   476	end
